items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: No, first time I played with him was in Chicago.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jabo Smith. I worked with him one night and Jabo come back the next night. That was his job. He just got off somewhere and didn't show up.
Have you played, you say, with Earl Wynn, you hadn't played with Earl Wynn down here, though? When did you?
In New Orleans? Yeah. No, first time I played with him was in Chicago. Yeah.
